verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents a first-party `cookies` parameter that passes custom cookies to the target page, so a developer can supply session cookies to fetch authenticated pages. The evidence is a single parameter-table line, not in-depth docs. `session_id` only pins the IP address and is not cookie handling. missing for 10: cookie format/syntax and multi-cookie or domain details, documentation of cookie behavior with JS rendering, independent or hands-on corroboration of authenticated scraping.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass my own session cookies so the API fetches pages requiring authentication

citations.quote: Pass custom cookies to the webpage you want to scrape
